prompt: Finish `line_col`, which turns a byte offset into a one-based line and column. Stop once we reach the offset, start a new line at a newline, and restart the column counter.
explain: Scanning stops as soon as the index reaches `pos`, so characters at or after it are not counted. A newline bumps the line and resets the column to 1 (columns are one-based), otherwise the column grows by one.
